anomalies.description: Two individuals engage in a violent physical fight inside a dimly lit wooden interior (likely a diner or bar). The sequence shows an initial close-range struggle (f0–f1), followed by one person lifting and slamming the other onto the floor (f2–f4), then grappling on the ground with repeated strikes and control attempts (f5–f15). Bystanders are visible but not participating.
Two individuals are engaged in close-quarters physical combat on the floor of a dimly lit interior space; one is on top of the other, grappling and struggling.
After the initial struggle, one individual (standing) repeatedly strikes or stomps on the other, who is lying prone and appears incapacitated on the floor—indicating an attack on a helpless victim.

Two individuals engage in a prolonged physical fight inside a diner, involving grappling, throws, and ground combat; the sequence shows continuous mutual combat with no clear separation into distinct phases.

Two individuals engage in close-quarters physical combat on the floor of a bar, involving grappling, rolling, and attempts to gain dominant position.; Two individuals engage in close-quarters physical combat on the floor of a bar; one is on top, grappling and striking the other who is lying supine.

After being subdued on the floor, one individual (in dark clothing) is struck repeatedly by the other while lying helpless; the attacker delivers multiple blows to the prone victim, indicating non-consensual violence against a defenseless person.

One individual is lying supine on the floor while the other kneels over them, holding their head/face in a controlling manner; the prone person appears restrained and unable to resist, indicating abuse rather than mutual combat.

After the initial struggle, the dominant individual (in dark hoodie) continues to assault the subdued person on the floor, including raising an arm as if to strike and pinning them, while the victim appears unable to resist.; The attacker (hooded figure) is now clearly dominant, lying partially on top of the victim, who lies motionless or minimally responsive on the floor; the attacker handles the victim’s limbs and torso without resistance, consistent with post-combat subjugation.

A brief resurgence of active resistance or counter-movement occurs as the person on the floor attempts to push or roll away, leading to renewed grappling (visible in f8–f10), indicating mutual engagement rather than purely one-sided abuse during this sub-interval.
